Instructions.Origin: held on to life for as long as they could.
Your 'Boss Checklist' is likely outdated. Please take some time to update it to the latest version!
Instructions.Translation: 你的'Boss清单'可能过旧,请花些时间更新版本!

Getting Biome Chest Set Amount From TerraCustom Settings
Instructions.Translation: 从自定义设置中获取生物群落宝箱的数量

Instructions.Origin: Getting Gem Cave Multipliers From TerraCustom Settings
Instructions.Translation: 从自定义设置中方获取宝石洞穴的倍增率

寻找合适地点的横坐标

Instructions.Origin: Digging a tunnel into the beach!

Instructions.Translation: 正在注水和使地形平滑！

Instructions.Origin: Some throwing items are now much weaker
Instructions.Translation: 一些投掷物品现在会弱很多
世界中未发现鲜血密室

Instructions.Origin: , gives me an ample supply of ore. I wonder where he gets it...
Instructions.Translation: 的矮子给了我一大堆矿物。我想知道他是哪里弄来的……

Instructions.Origin: , keeps trying to sell me trashy tools. As if I couldn't make my own!
Instructions.Translation: 的老头总是试着向我推销一些没用的东西。搞得好像我做不出来似的！

Instructions.Origin: Even a broken clock is right every week! Or was it a day...?
Instructions.Translation: 就算是一座坏钟，也不会差一个星期！或者一天就够多了……？

Instructions.Origin: Always strike while the iron is hot! Don't let a good opportunity pass you by...
Instructions.Translation: 一定要趁热打铁！不要失去大好机会……

Instructions.Origin: You won't find a better blacksmith in all of Terraria! What's that, you're a smith too? Oh...
Instructions.Translation: 泰拉瑞亚世界里没有比我更好的铁匠了。什么？你也是个铁匠？哦……

Instructions.Origin: I'm always trying to make the perfect armor. Perhaps you can help me out?
Instructions.Translation: 我一直在尝试打造出一套完美的盔甲。也许你能帮我的忙？

Instructions.Origin: have a little routine going: he delivers me metal to smith, and I give him a heart attack by smoking near his explosives on purpose.
make a knife out of chocolate that's better than half of my own blades...
think he's doing trying to offer his cheap trash he calls 'weapons'? If you want the real deal, you've come to the right place!
is more Barbarian than Tracker! Do you have any idea how many times the oaf asked me to fix that battleaxe of his?!
Don't forget to wipe your blade if you're planning on going out there! I don't care how magical it is, those freaks' blood will rust any metal!

You know all those special weapons you find scattered about the land? I've always wondered just how they were forged in the first place. I'm an old man now, but I've still got a long journey to mastery ahead of me...
Every blade's got its place in the world: a signature weapon for a hero, a beloved knife for a chef, or maybe just some gaudy piece of junk hanging from a wall.
Hey brat, corral some people into helping me out at the forge. Blacksmithing ain't a single-man task, and you'll just end up with second-rate junk if you try going solo!

'course I followed you here, brat. I crash-coursed you on how to forge and smith weapons for yourself before you arrived here, I'll be damned if I don't get to sit back and watch the ensuing fireworks.
Welcome! I'm busy workin' on a commission weapon, if you touch anything, consider it sold!
wanted to throw me a birthday party? I haven't had one in so long!
Instructions.Translation: 想给我办场生日派对吗？我有好长时间没有过过生日了！

Instructions.Origin: might be even older than I am!
has been giving you advice this whole time? It's always nice to see a young man appreciate his studies.
Instructions.Translation: 一直在给你提供帮助？看到你这样的年轻人欣赏他的学识可真好。

Instructions.Origin: In my younger years, I myself was a hero. But after a bad fall, I've since retired. Perhaps if I had better boots back then I would still be a hero today...
Instructions.Translation: 我年轻时曾是个英雄，直到我摔了一跤。如果那时我有一双更好的鞋，可能我现在依旧是个英雄吧……

Instructions.Origin: Worry not young hero. While the journey may be tough, I have full confidence in your ability!
Instructions.Translation: 年轻的勇者，不要担心。虽然旅途艰难，我依然相信你的能力！

Instructions.Origin: Having proper footwear is no joke,
Instructions.Translation: 有一双好鞋子可不是瞎说，

Instructions.Origin: . Always make sure your shoes are polished and ready for adventure!
Instructions.Translation: 。要确认你的鞋子油光发亮，能够冒险后再出发！

Instructions.Origin: You can learn a lot by walking a mile in someone else's boots. If only some of these townsfolk would walk a mile in yours, then they could understand...
Instructions.Translation: 穿别人的鞋子走走，你会学到很多。如果你的房客也穿着你的走走，那他们也会明白这个道理……

Instructions.Origin: ? Are you staying safe out there in the wilds?
While the journey may be tough, I have full confidence in your ability!
There we go, good as new! Make sure to stay safe out there, hero.
Instructions.Translation: 芜湖，光亮如新！在外面记得多保重，年轻的英雄。

Instructions.Origin: I'm afraid I can't make them any more shiny than they already are... Come back later when you get a little more dirt on them!
Instructions.Translation: 恐怕连我不能把它们擦得更亮了……等你的鞋子上面沾了点灰再来找我吧！

Instructions.Origin: , good as new. It won't last long, but maybe you'll notice some more spring in your step. Make sure to stay safe out there, hero!
Instructions.Translation: ，简直光亮如新！虽然这不会保持很长时间，但你能注意到你的鞋底更有弹性了。在外面记得多保重，英雄！

Instructions.Origin: has a big juicy brain... not that I would wanna... uh... did you need something?
Instructions.Translation: 一定有一个鲜美多汁的大脑……要不就是……额……你需要什么东西吗？

Instructions.Origin: 's brain would surely taste like candy... Oh uh, hello there!
Instructions.Translation: 的大脑一定像糖一样甜美……噢，额……你好啊！

Instructions.Origin: I can't remember much about my past life... Chemicals and the like were my passion I think; I only get fragments and pieces of the truth. It's saddening at times...
Instructions.Translation: 我对于过去已经记不太清了……我只记得化学药物和……某种激情吧，我只能记得些许片段。这些记忆只会凭添忧伤……

Instructions.Origin: Why am I not like the others...? Oh, I'm sorry, did you need something friend?
Instructions.Translation: 为什么我和其他人不一样呢……？噢，对不起朋友，你需要什么吗？

Instructions.Origin: Most people don't have the stomach to handle the things I sell. The trick is to not have a stomach at all!
Instructions.Translation: 大多数人看了我的东西都会反胃。没有胃就完全不会有这种问题！

Instructions.Origin: I gotta thank you for letting me stick around. Only coming out at night is pretty boring...
Instructions.Translation: 感谢你让我留下。只能在夜晚出去有些无聊……

Instructions.Origin: Why am I not like the others...? Oh, I'm sorry, did you need something?
I just whipped up the perfect recipe to deter bats from bothering you; no more tiny nibbles!
Instructions.Translation: 我刚刚调配了能完美驱散蝙蝠的配方，你可以不用担心再被它们叮咬了！

Instructions.Origin: If this turned out correctly, you'll smell just like a zombie. Hopefully your nights will be a tad more calm!
Instructions.Translation: 如果这玩意管用的话，你闻起来会像只僵尸。希望它能让你晚上在外面更安全点。

Instructions.Origin: Getting this stuff to work underwater was a huge hassle... Either way, hungry fish shouldn't attempt to eat you with this.
Instructions.Translation: 让这玩意能在水里起效可把我折腾坏了……总之，现在你不用害怕被那些饥饿的鱼类啃了。

Instructions.Origin: I'll be honest, this is just a bottle of pure liquid calcium. Don't question it, the skeletons surely won't.
Instructions.Translation: 实话实说，这玩意简直就是一瓶液态钙。别怀疑它的可行性，至少那些骷髅肯定不会怀疑你。

Instructions.Origin: With this nasty concoction, insects will associate your scent with their queen! Neat, huh?
Instructions.Translation: 用这种恶心的混融物，那些昆虫肯定会把你和它们的女王搞混！多省事，你说是吧？

Instructions.Origin: Looks like you're a bit short on funds. Come back to me when you have a little more coin in your pocket!
Instructions.Translation: 看起来你现在手头有点紧，等你钱包鼓起来了再来找我吧。

Instructions.Origin: I'm afraid you'll have to give me some more time to prepare the next repellent. This stuff can get pretty complicated...
Instructions.Translation: 恐怕我还得多花一会准备下一种驱散剂。这些东西真的很复杂……

Instructions.Origin: is so stingy with his fish. He has a million of them and he can't spare a single one for some fish fillet?
Instructions.Translation: 那个小孩居然这么珍惜他的鱼。他有一百万条鱼为什么却不肯拿出一条做鱼柳呢？

Instructions.Origin: is no easy task. She simply refuses to eat any form of meat!
Instructions.Translation: 做菜可真麻烦。她拒绝吃任何肉类食品！

Instructions.Origin: asked me to cook for him, he requested bugs! This truly is a strange place...
Instructions.Translation: 要我给他做饭时，他居然要求用虫子做食材！这真是个奇怪的地方……

Instructions.Origin: I've got a lot of orders from the other townsfolk right now, make it quick!
Instructions.Translation: 我刚刚接到了好多人的订单，快一点！

Instructions.Origin: How did any of you survive before I arrived? What could you have possibly been eating, dirt?
Instructions.Translation: 在我来之前你们是怎么活下来的？难道你们吃土吗？

Instructions.Origin: I'm stuck with dull knives while you wield weapons of unimaginable power? Give me a break...
Instructions.Translation: 你已经在用强大的神器了而我却还在用着普通菜刀？让我静静……

Instructions.Origin: No one should go adventuring on an empty stomach. Eat well, hero!
Instructions.Translation: 没有人会饿着肚子出去冒险。多吃点，我的勇士！

Instructions.Origin: Supply me with the proper ingredients, and I can make some truly powerful foods for you, hero!
Instructions.Translation: 给我些合适的原材料，我能给你做出几道大餐，勇士！

Instructions.Origin: can be a real brat at times, but as long as he keeps providing me with fresh fish, I won't complain.
Instructions.Translation: 有时候真是个混蛋，但只要他肯一直给我提供新鲜的鱼，我就不会抱怨。

Instructions.Origin: Ah, just enough blueberries to start making blueberry salad. Please enjoy,
Instructions.Translation: 啊，这份量刚好足够做一份蓝莓沙拉。请享用吧，

Instructions.Origin: This crisp morel was just asking to be put in a dish. I hope it's to your liking!
Instructions.Translation: 热腾又酥脆的羊肚菌，新鲜出炉。希望这个合你胃口！

Instructions.Origin: Pink pears can be problematic if prepared improperly. Good thing I'm a professional pear pickler!
Instructions.Translation: 仙人掌花料理不当吃下去可是会出麻烦的。但我是专业的

Instructions.Origin: Well uh... I DID cook it, though I'm not entirely sure you should eat this stuff.
Instructions.Translation: 啊额……这确实是我做的，但我不确定你是否应该吃这玩意。

Instructions.Origin: With just the right amount of green, this dish gets real mean. Be careful eating it!
Instructions.Translation: 要想菜品过得去，碗里总得带点绿。吃这玩意的时候小心点！

Instructions.Origin: Not a single wheat stalk in sight... I guess kelp can suffice as a noodle, if prepared correctly at least.
Instructions.Translation: 这里甚至连一颗小麦都找不到……我想料理得当的话，海带也能凑合当面条吃，大概吧。

Instructions.Origin: When I was younger, my mother would always greet me with some ice cold lemonade after a day of playing in the sun... I miss the simpler times.
Instructions.Translation: 我小的时候，哥哥总是会在我结束一整天太阳下的玩闹后递上一杯透心凉的柠檬水……那可是真是段无忧无虑的好时光。

Instructions.Origin: Yunno, it's not just called a 'Sky Blue Flower' because of its color. Some say they've fallen from the sky islands themselves long ago.
Instructions.Translation: 你懂的，它不仅仅是因为颜色才被叫做“天蓝花”，传说它们是古时候从浮空岛上陨坠地面的物种。

Instructions.Origin: Last time I took a swig of this stuff, I started thinking everything was out to get me... but hey, maybe that's what you're looking for?
Instructions.Translation: 上次我喝这玩意的时候，我感觉全世界都在“针对”我……喂等等，不会这就是你所想要的效果吧？

Instructions.Origin: Ah, glowing mushrooms, a staple in the diet of a terrarian! Hopefully this recipe offers a little more 'pizazz' to its taste.
Instructions.Translation: 啊，发光蘑菇，舌尖上的泰拉的著名菜点！希望这道菜谱能使它的口味更加得“活泼”

Instructions.Origin: I'm honored that you'd trust me with such rare commodities. Hopefully this new recipe suits your fancy!
Instructions.Translation: 从你这拿到如此珍贵的材料我实在是受宠若惊。愿这道新品不会辜负你的期待！

Instructions.Origin: I myself don't know much about the Hallow, it's a rather strange place... but berries are berries, right?
Instructions.Translation: 我其实对神圣之地没什么了解，那儿好像挺奇怪的……但说到底哪儿的浆果都是浆果，对吧？

Instructions.Origin: So the legends are true... The kitchen scholars thought this recipe was lost to time, but it's right in front of me. I can barely contain my excitement to try it out!
Instructions.Translation: 所以……传说是真的……历代厨神都认为这道菜谱早已佚失，但现在它就摆在我的面前。我和我的厨具已经按捺不住了！

Instructions.Origin: I can tell this was written by an ogre... still, the pictures give me a clear idea on how to brew this. Be careful with this stuff, it's highly potent!
Instructions.Translation: 我能看出来这是食人魔写的……行吧，至少这些图形把酿造步骤画的还挺明白。喝这玩意的时候小心点，它劲很大。

Instructions.Origin: Leaves? You want me to cook some food... with leaves? Well, I don't think these would really work in a salad, so how about some tea instead? I'm sure it will calm you down if you're stressed.
Instructions.Translation: 树叶？你想让我用这给你做食物……难办。好吧好吧，我不觉得这些叶子适合做沙拉，那么来杯茶如何？我肯定这能让你精神振奋！

Instructions.Origin: These were exactly what I was missing for my special hot chocolate recipe! If you're planning on going somewhere a little chilly, these will warm you right up for sure.
Instructions.Translation: 你身上一种食物原料都没有啊。如果你能把食品原料带给我的话，我就能额外卖给你些食物。那可是比我平时卖的更强力的稀奇货色。眼睛放尖点，找到独特的原材料就拿给我看看！

Instructions.Origin: Looks like you don't have any ingredients in your bag. If you can find enough of an ingredient I'm looking for, I can supply you with new purchasable foods. Some of these dishes will be far more powerful than my usual wares, so keep your eyes peeled for unique ingredients!
Instructions.Translation: 这正是我特制热巧克力配方所需要的！如果你想去些寒冷的地方，这杯肯定能让你从头暖到脚！

Instructions.Origin: Ah, glowing mushrooms, a staple in the diet of a Terrarian! Hopefully this recipe offers a little more 'pizazz' to its taste.
Instructions.Translation: 啊，发光蘑菇，舌尖上的泰拉的著名菜点！希望这道菜谱能使它的口味更加得“活泼”

Instructions.Origin: was interested in dyeing my attire, but his choice of plant dye was 'strange' to say the least.
Instructions.Translation: 很想给我的衣服染色，但是他选择的植物染料只能说非常奇葩。

Instructions.Origin: over there! He's got an entire arsenal of guns, is that really safe?
Instructions.Translation: ，他仿佛带着一整个军火库的武器，这真的安全吗？

Instructions.Origin: We certainly have some strange people around this town, don't we...?
Instructions.Translation: 这个小镇有很多奇怪的人，不是吗……？

Instructions.Origin: You didn't see any giant bird shadows while you were out in the desert, did you?
Instructions.Translation: 你走出沙漠的时候有没有看见过巨大的鸟类的影子？

Instructions.Origin: I had originally stopped just to refill my canteen, but you seem like someone who can deal with a real threat!
Instructions.Translation: 我本来只是想停下来填饱肚子，但是你看起来像是能够解决大危机的人！

Instructions.Origin: Have you ever heard tale of the Thunder Birds? Legend says they had long protected our world from cataclysmic threats, before a disagreement between them and three individuals led to their disappearance...
Instructions.Translation: 你听过惊雷王鹰的传说吗？传说它们一直在保护我们的世界免遭灾难威胁，直到它们与一种存在产生冲突并消失……

Instructions.Origin: I have seen so much evil in my travels... I only hope someone can put a stop to them!
Instructions.Translation: 我旅行的时候见过许多邪恶的存在……我希望有人能够消灭他们！

Instructions.Origin: If you're interested in the secrets of my people, be sure to purchase a 'Blank Technique Scroll'. They offer great power to those that utilize them well...
Instructions.Translation: 如果你对我手下的秘密感兴趣，一定要购买“空白秘技卷轴”。善用它们会为你带来巨大的帮助……

Instructions.Origin: Although I'm only an acolyte, one of the first things we learn is how to create a sandstorm. Beware the creatures that lurk within however...
Instructions.Translation: 虽然我只是个侍者，但我们侍者学会做的第一件事就是引发沙尘暴。但千万记得当心潜伏于沙暴中的存在……

Instructions.Origin: Creating a sandstorm is a very taxing job. I would prefer to have some compensation in the form of money, please.
Instructions.Translation: 制造一场沙尘暴是一项繁重的任务。我希望获得一点世俗的回报……没错，要钱的。

Instructions.Origin: Visiting that sea rift again wasn't my best idea... that mutant jellyfish almost ate me whole!
Instructions.Translation: 我再也不想去海里那个大裂缝玩了……那里巨大的水母几乎能一口吃掉了我！

Instructions.Origin: Yuck... that vile creature almost got away with eating me! Thank you for saving me, hero.
Instructions.Translation: 妈的……那个邪恶的生物差点吃了我！谢谢你救了我，英雄。

Instructions.Origin: and me go way back. He wasn't always a salt water scourge, yunno'.
Instructions.Translation: 已经是老交情了。你知道吧，他并不总是在海上兴风作浪。

Instructions.Origin: , thinks he knows so much about the sea...
Instructions.Translation: 的小呆瓜还以为他很了解大海……

Instructions.Origin: Have you adventured into the aquatic depths yet...? Its choking atmosphere prevents most explorers from entering, but I'm confident you'll find a way around it...
Instructions.Translation: 你去过海底深渊吗……？那里的窒息环境让大多数人都望洋兴叹，但是我相信你一定有办法的……

Instructions.Origin: I've collected many marine items in my travels, hero. Would you like to purchase one?
Instructions.Translation: 我旅行的时候收集了许多海洋物资。你想买点吗？

Instructions.Origin: Being at the bottom of the ocean for long periods of time has taught me one thing. Always come prepared!
Instructions.Translation: 长期在海底的经历教会了我一件事。一定要做好充分的准备！

Instructions.Origin: You ever try to drink a bottle of water, while drowning, to save yourself? I know I have!
Instructions.Translation: 你有试过在溺水的时候喝一瓶水来自救吗？我曾经试过！

Instructions.Origin: Being at the bottom of the ocean for long periods of time has taught me one thing; Always come prepared!
Instructions.Translation: 长期在海底的经历教会了我一件事。一定要做好充分的准备！

Instructions.Origin: You would think it gets hard to breath under this helmet, but really I'm just used to it now.
Here you go friend! This air tank will automatically activate when your breath reaches critical level. Come visit me afterwards and I'll refill it free of charge!
Instructions.Translation: 拿着，朋友！这个空气罐会在你呼吸困难的关头自动启用。以后想找我把它重新填满就尽管开口，我不收你一分钱！

Instructions.Origin: Let me refill that air tank for you, friend. Do continue to take caution out there; Terraria needs you alive and well...
Instructions.Translation: 让我帮你把它填满，朋友。记得时刻保持警惕……泰拉大陆还需要你……

Instructions.Origin: Hmm, your air tank looks full to me... Did you just want to chat? I have all manner of tales to tell!
Instructions.Translation: 嗯？这空气罐看起来还是满的……还是说你只是想聊聊？我可有一肚子故事可以讲！

Instructions.Origin: Ever since I was a child, I've always wanted to meet a dryad. What luck it is to find
Instructions.Translation: 我从小就特别想见到森林女神，结果我竟然在这遇见了

Instructions.Origin: , is rather strange isn't he? He speaks in riddles...
Instructions.Translation: 的朋友的吗？他很奇怪对吧？他总是在说谜语……

Instructions.Origin: I wonder if I can convince
to whip me up a salad.
Why don't you go fetch those seeds yourself you lazy, good for nothing-
Instructions.Translation: 你为什么不去自己采一些草药呢，一无是处的懒人（￣へ￣）

Instructions.Origin: I bet you don't even feel guilty about destroying and killing the natural world to better suit your needs...
Instructions.Translation: 我打赌你在为了一己私欲破坏环境屠杀生命后一点都不感到愧疚……

Instructions.Origin: Getting these seeds is a bigger hassle than you would think. Nearly drowning, almost melting, freezing to- You get the idea.
Instructions.Translation: 得到这些草药的过程比你想象的艰苦多了。差点淹死、烧死、冻死在……你明白就好。

Instructions.Origin: I often take visits to the jungle. I can understand the aversion to the place, but the creatures within don't seem to hassle me...
Instructions.Translation: 我经常去丛林。我能理解为什么大部分冒险者厌恶那里，但是那里的生物似乎不会为难我……

Instructions.Origin: My mother was a well known herbalist back in the day. She doesn't talk about my father, though. I wonder why?
Instructions.Translation: 我的母亲曾经也是位知名药师。她从来没提起过我的父亲……我想知道这是为什么……

Instructions.Origin: ? Make sure to stop and smell the roses!
Instructions.Translation: 你今天过的怎么样？记得停在玫瑰前，享受一下它们散发的香气！

Instructions.Origin: The natural world is quite a wonder. Every little place has its own charm. Some more than others!
Instructions.Translation: 自然世界真是奇妙，每一个地方都有迷人的魅力，况且你还能找到更迷人的地方！

Instructions.Origin: I bet you don't even feel guilty about destroying the natural world to better suit your needs...
Even a small seed can grow into a mighty oak! Keep that in mind,
Is- Is that my cross? How in the world did you manage to find it? It's been lost for so long...
Instructions.Translation: 那，那是我的十字架？你是怎么找到它的？它已经丢失很久了……

Instructions.Origin: often comes to me in private to discuss things that are bothering him. Such a young age to be in his position...
Instructions.Translation: 经常过来跟我说一些他的烦心事。人生的这种阶段对于他来说似乎有点太早了……

Instructions.Origin: and I spent all of last night discussing philosophy. That one has a wise head on his shoulders.
Instructions.Translation: 和我谈论了一晚上的哲学。他有着一颗睿智的头脑。

Instructions.Origin: Beware my friend... true evil walks among us this night.
Instructions.Translation: 小心，我的朋友……今晚真正的邪恶会穿行于我们之间。

Instructions.Origin: Ah, it's been a while friend. It is good to see you are well after so long!
Instructions.Translation: 啊，朋友。好久不见，看起来你的状况不错！

Instructions.Origin: Not all who wander are lost, remember this friend...
Instructions.Translation: 并非所有流浪者都迷失了自我，记住这句话，朋友……

Instructions.Origin: Energy, chi, spirit... it's all the same to me. There is power in all things.
Instructions.Translation: 能量，气，灵魂……对我来说都是一样的。万物皆有灵。

Instructions.Origin: I have no doubt of your physical power, hero. But sometimes hardship is fought in a battle of will, not strength.
Instructions.Translation: 毋庸置疑，你的身体的确很强壮，勇者。但有的时候一场战争的决定因素是意志，而非体格。

Instructions.Origin: I'm afraid I can't currently protect you. The residual energy from my power is still interfering with my attempts to empower you.
Instructions.Translation: 恐怕我现在不能保护你。来自你体内的残余能量阻止我赋予你新的力量。

Instructions.Origin: With these shards, I have imbued you with an incredibly potent shield. Should you take fatal damage, you shall receive my protection for as long as I can hold it. Stay safe out there, my friend.
Instructions.Translation: 有了这些碎片，我塑造了一面强大的护盾。护盾会保护你免受致命伤害在我力所能及的范围内。在外面注意安全，我的朋友。

Instructions.Origin: I require no money to watch over you my friend, but my protection is limited without some Purified Shards. Once you acquire some, come visit me again.
Instructions.Translation: 我无法用钱来保护你，朋友。没有纯净碎片我就无法发挥全力。一旦你找到一些碎片，立马回来找我。

Instructions.Origin: No need to fear my friend, my power is already protecting you. Come back when my power has faded.
Instructions.Translation: 无需恐惧，我的朋友，我的力量会保护你。当力量衰弱时回来找我。

Instructions.Origin: How well can you carry a tune?
You know, people would pay good money for quality music like yours. Care to hear my business proposition...?
Instructions.Translation: 你知道，人们会花钱买你这样的优质音乐。想听听我的商业建议吗？

Instructions.Origin: In my younger years I was quite the experienced bard too! I've since left that behind me, though.
Instructions.Translation: 在我年轻的时候，我也是一个很有经验的吟游诗人！不过，从那以后我就把它忘了……

Instructions.Origin: Are you sure you really need my help healing you and your allies? You seem to have it under control...
Instructions.Translation: 你确定你真的需要我的帮助来治愈你和你的队友吗？你似乎已经处理妥善了……

Instructions.Origin: Another healer in town? Ugh, this will be bad for business...
Instructions.Translation: 镇子上的另一位治疗者？额，这年头生意不好做啊……

Instructions.Origin: Aye, so the legends be true... A great and terrible beast lurks beneath the depths, matey. Best if you go and handle it, eh?
Instructions.Translation: 啊，所以传说是真的……一只又大又可怕的野兽潜伏在深处， 哥们。最好你去处理这件事，好吗？

Instructions.Origin: Aye, I once saw a sea demon risin' from those depths. Somethin' dark, somethin' ancient, somethin'... uhh... You gonna buy somethin'?!
Instructions.Translation: 是啊，我曾经看到过一个海妖从深海里爬出来。最黑暗，最古老，最……你要买东西吗？

Instructions.Origin: Got a special deal for ya, straight from this poor lot who wandered into that old Bat's lair unprepared.
Instructions.Translation: 有一个特别的交易给你，这是从那个老家伙身上得来的，他毫无准备地闯进了那个老蝙蝠的巢穴。

Instructions.Origin: You see a lot when you wander these buried caverns. Why just the other day I stumbled upon some sort of 'blood stained chamber'. I wonder what its purpose was...?
Instructions.Translation: 当你漫步于这些地下洞穴时，你会看到很多东西。就在前几天我偶然发现了某种“血迹斑斑的房间”。我很想知道它的作用是什么……

Instructions.Origin: There's no chefs in all of
Instructions.Translation: 这儿没有一个像样的厨子

Instructions.Origin: I couldn't believe my eyes when I saw
walk into town! Now I can lounge back and let HIM do all the cooking!
Instructions.Translation: 走在镇子里时，我简直不敢相信我的眼睛！现在我可以休息一下，然后将所有的烹饪任务都交给他了！

Instructions.Origin: Yeah, yeah, everyone's going crazy over your 'saving the world' thing. But have you saved the 200 fancy fish I've asked for? If not then it's back to work, minion!

'Ocean Essences', huh? Do you think if I have enough, I'll become the Supreme God-Emperor of all Fishkind?! I've got a new quest for you, Supreme Helper Minion! Get for me 100 MILLION of those Ocean thingies, pronto!
Peace is all fine and dandy, but what am I supposed to use as target practice now?!
Heh, I told you from day one, brat: I came here to watch the fireworks, and you sure delivered.
Ever since you freed me from my curse, I figured you were tailor-made for this whole hero business.

I can't believe it, never in a million years... But look at you, standing so triumphantly! Ha ha hah! Congratulations, but more importantly: thank you, from the bottom of my heart, hero. Thanks to your incredible bravery, an old friend of mine can rest easy now...
I barely remember anything from before I died, but that doesn't mean I can't make new memories. I'll be sure to remember your victory for as long as this body can move!
I could see the battle from here. To think you would risk your life to save us from something as overwhelming as... that. Take a seat kid, I'll cook your favorite meal - it's on me.
Simply incredible. I had calculated your odds of survival at less than 0.001% against those creatures and yet here you stand. Truly the will of man is a thing of wonder.
What a series of fireworks that purple guy let out! Can't help but take it as a challenge; one pyrotechnics show that'll blow your socks off, comin' right up!
It seems I was right to place my trust in you, my friend. You've protected us from every threat that arose, and for that, I'm truly grateful. Maybe now I can finally relax a little.
Not bad, kid... Not bad at all. Hopefully you've had fun during all of your adventures out there. I guess you could say I've always been keeping an eye on you.

Normally I'd say something like, 'nature finds a way', but I'm not even sure if Mother Nature could survive if you failed to stop those spirits' carnage... Please take these lilies, in gratitude for your courage!
To think a threat even more dangerous than the Moon Lord existed out there... It makes me wonder what else lies beyond what we see. Let's not worry about that for now though,
Ah... must you keep that crown above your head, darling? The colors are rich, but its aesthetic is... garish.
I thought for sure we were all doomed when those creatures emerged so I jumped the gun on a confession of mine. It ended up working out though, so maybe I'm glad we almost all died!

Congratulations on your victory! I'm sure you've already noticed, but each of the primordial spirits left behind part of their essence over the domain they control after you defeated them. They're as powerful as they sound, and you can make some extremely potent gear with them. As always, I can help you see what you can craft with them!
It seems like things are gonna be a lot more peaceful from here on out. Maybe now I can finally focus on my machines... and maybe someone special to me.
Amazing work, friend! I sold off all my 'end of the world' merchandise, and now thanks to you, I can actually live long enough to kick back and enjoy the benefits!
I assume that you won't be having too many injuries from here on out? Shame, there goes my greatest money maker.

I see you're quite the curious person... Thought I might say something interesting, hm? Well savor your victory for now. Our true master will return one day, and when he does, this world will know death once more.
! I'm already starting my newest masterpiece: a capturing of your stupendous battle!
That crown! Does that mean you're now the
OF THE UNIVERSE?! Do you know what this calls for?! The greatest coronation party EVER!!

Best be reckonin' that travelin' the seven seas will be smoother sailin' than a newborn's behind now that the Lady High Tide has been quell'd... And prob'ly high time for this ol' swashbuckler to set voyage for a new adventure!
If saving the world doesn't make you a good
, then I don't know what does. No coal for you this year!
Take a gander at that crown above your head! Just which poor sap did you nab that from?
From the moment we first spoke I sensed something special within you. Your spirit exudes an incredible energy, one that I'm honored to have witnessed. Stay golden my friend.
An endless source of fire and water fell from those creatures you say? Oy, that sounds like a great way to generate some steam!
Wasn't aware the primordial forces of Terraria had a sense of humor. 'I saved the world and all I got was this gaudy crown' and all that, right hun?
Well now. Even back in Etheria I haven't seen a hero defend their home with such bravery and tenacity before. Maybe you do measure up after all.
I see that fancy crown above your head, alright. Bah! You already acted like a despot, now you have the looks to back it up. Just separate me from my lovely gold and leave!
A reality-ending nightmare entity, kid? You certainly don't cut corners, there's no way I can top that!
Hey, I'm back in town! Did I miss anything exciting...?
I would have never seen the things I've seen recently if I had stayed underground, so thank you for that wonderful - and totally not at all terrifying - show!

I was exiled from my people when I chose to side with your kind. They thought me foolish, placing faith in those that dwelled above. I'm sure they're feeling rather foolish themselves after what you've just accomplished. Well done,
Heroism inspires legends, legends inspire heroism.
Everyone is quite lively right now! I'm so glad all of you remembered that today was my birthday!
Seen any interesting beasts lurking around lately? Minotaurs? Beholders? Gorgons?
Instructions.Translation: 看到过任何在四周徘徊潜伏的敌人了吗？比如牛头人？巨石模仿者？或是蛇发女妖什么的？

Instructions.Origin: Bear your scars with pride, as each one has a tale to tell... What do your scars say about you hero?
Instructions.Translation: 露出你那代表荣耀的伤疤吧，每个伤疤都见证了一段传奇……你的伤疤的背后又有一段怎样的故事呢，英雄？

Instructions.Origin: Many beasts have fallen to me and my blade, but new ones are always on the prowl. Keep your eyes peeled, kid.
Instructions.Translation: 许多凶猛的怪物成为了我的刀下亡魂，但新的怪物正在潜伏窥视。睁大你的双眼，小子。

Instructions.Origin: You'd be surprised how effective a single shoulder pad can be.
Instructions.Translation: 你会对一个坚实的皮甲所产生的效果而感到惊讶的。

, and I were gonna start a gym together. You want in?

Instructions.Origin: Long ago, when this world was first taking form, my race reigned supreme. That time has passed it seems...
Instructions.Translation: 很久很久以前，世界刚刚成型的时候，我们这个种族处于统治地位。那实在是太久远的过去了……

Instructions.Origin: I'm not one for idle chatter. If you have need of me, make it quick.
Instructions.Translation: 我不是一个爱说废话的人。如果你需要我，就快点决定。

Instructions.Origin: My race's obsession with voodoo dolls has only become rampant just recently. It's truly a fad gone wrong...
Instructions.Translation: 最近我的族人突然开始疯狂喜欢巫毒娃娃。那真是奇怪的流行文化……

Instructions.Origin: Should you have the coin, I would be willing to accompany you in your endeavors...
Instructions.Translation: 只要你付钱，我就会为你而战……

Instructions.Origin: A warrior without his weapon stands no chance against the ever-powering threats he must face...
Instructions.Translation: 没有武器的战士是不能击败他必须面对的强大对手的……

Instructions.Translation: 茫然的看着你，就好像他不在那里一样……

Instructions.Origin: I see you're lacking in coin. Remedy that and I may just help you out...
Instructions.Translation: 我看你是付不起吧。纠正这个错误，我或许会助你一臂之力……

Instructions.Origin: Aquaius can't take the trauma. Its form ripples and disperses!
Instructions.Translation: 潮汐之灵不堪重创。它的形体崩解消逝了！

Instructions.Translation: 潮汐之灵的无尽绝望之力无法被这个世界容纳！

Instructions.Translation: 小子，我这有个私人合同给你……我一般不会请你做这种事，但听我说完。多年以前，我和我的搭档李小龙一起出去闯荡江湖。我俩当年可是所向披靡，直到我们在一次异常困难的任务里犯下了致命的错误。为了救我，他被困在了地牢里，现在早已化作了一具枯骨。至今我都没能原谅当时我独自苟活……求你了，进入地牢，让他饱受折磨的灵魂安息吧……

Instructions.Origin: You've done me a favor I could never repay in a thousand lifetimes. What I would give to apologize to Lee face to face... I'm confident, that at this point, you've surpassed any strength we thought we possessed. It's sobering to be humbled by an upstart like you, kid. As a reward, I've got a collection of weapons Lee would often use. I'm sure he would be honored if you wielded them in battle. Take care out there!
Instructions.Translation: 你帮了我个大忙，我永生难忘。哎，我多么希望我能面对面地向他道歉……我相当肯定你已经拥有了超越了我们当年的实力。时代变了，小子，被你这样的后起之秀超过还真是发人深省。作为报酬，这些是李小龙当年用过的武器……你在战斗中使用它们，他的在天之灵大概也会感到欣慰吧。多保重!

Instructions.Origin: I'm sure you've seen that unregulated spirit magic can lead to a lot of things, such as possessed weapons and armor. That prospect alone is terrifying, but when powerful artifacts are possessed, things can get ugly... Keep your eyes peeled for aggressive Enchanted weapons deep underground.
Instructions.Translation: 我非常确定你明白不受控制的魔力附于物体上会发生什么，看看那些魔化的武器和盔甲就能明白。光是想想就令人毛骨悚然，尤其是更为强力的器具被魔化时，事情就会变得相当棘手……眼睛放尖点，地底深处那些险恶的附魔武器，一把也别放过。

Instructions.Origin: Alright kid, I think we should start you off easy... I've tracked down a group of wild creatures deep beneath our surface. On your adventures underground, you may encounter formidable creatures known as Crawdads, Salamanders and Giant Shellys. Taking out a couple of them would make the world a lot safer, and let me sleep peacefully for the night.
Instructions.Translation: 好了小子，我觉得我们应该先从简单的开始……我追踪了一些地下的野生生物。在你的探险途中，你可能会遇到些难缠的龙虾、蝾螈和巨型卷壳怪。干掉他们能使这个世界变得更安全，这样我晚上也能睡得更安稳。

Instructions.Origin: Not bad at all, kid. Hopefully it wasn't too hard hunting one down. You may have noticed they dropped a 'Vanquisher Medal'. With those, you can redeem them for items I keep on me. Typically, they relate to the tracked creature, so be sure to visit me after completing any contracts.
Instructions.Translation: 不错小子，干得不错。希望你狩猎的时候没遇上太多困难。你可能注意到了它们掉落了一枚“征服者勋章”。用这个可以从我这儿兑换些道具。大多是和合同怪物相关的道具，每次合同完成后别忘了来看看。

Instructions.Origin: Many adventurers have braved the intense foliage of the jungle, but even fewer return. I sent a friend of mine, Doctor Bones, out on a mission to the jungle quite a while ago, but he hasn't returned... Could you go check out the jungle's surface at night and see if you can find any signs of him?
Instructions.Translation: 很多探险者在茂密的雨林中闯荡，能回来的不过寥寥几位。好一阵子前我为一位探险家朋友，印第安纳·骨斯博士送行，可是他现在还没有回来……你能在晚上去丛林地表找找关于他的线索吗？

Instructions.Origin: Radiant beasts have been spotted prowling underground Terraria, illuminating a path of ruin. The Gilded Bat, Gilded Lycan and Gilded Slime light up their surrounding area and pack quite a punch. It would be best if their numbers dwindled, even just a little...
Instructions.Translation: 发光的野兽在泰拉大陆的地底梭巡，把沿途搅得一团糟。黄金蝙蝠、黄金狼人和黄金史莱姆会发光，它们看着相当显眼。这些生物的数量应该尽可能少，能少一点是一点。

Instructions.Origin: Many try to take shortcuts in their quest for power, often calling upon the elements for their boon. But while the elements can provide what they seek, it comes with a hefty price. There exists beings known as Hags that roam the world looking to steal back their traded youth. The Underworld, Jungle, Ocean, and Sky are the most likely spots to find one. Do us a favor and take one out.
Instructions.Translation: 许多人在追求力量的道路上企图一蹴而就，召唤元素之灵以祈求恩泽。然而元素灵虽然能够给予他们所需的力量，却也同时从他们身上索取沉重的代价。那些被称作巫婆的存在在世界各个角落漫游，企图从别人身上偷回她们那作为代价被抽走的青春。地狱、丛林、海洋和天空，任由你去哪，总之你需要去干掉她们其中的一位。

Instructions.Origin: Defeat the terrifying Wall of Flesh to continue...
Instructions.Translation: 击败恐怖的血肉之墙以继续……

Instructions.Origin: Better pack some warm clothes for this one kid; this automaton, crafted from the coldest ice you can fathom, only appears in raging blizzards. Its deadly frost beams will freeze you solid if you aren't careful, so keep on the move and hide behind cover!
Instructions.Translation: 你最好为此行多备点保暖衣裳，小子。这台自动机由极寒冰晶铸造，且只在最为凌冽的暴风雪中现身。如果你不小心的话，它的冰霜射线会将当场你冻成一尊冰雕，所以记得保持移动并寻找掩体。

Instructions.Origin: I don't know what you did out there, kid, but things have gotten a lot more hectic. With the released spirits possessing our world, you can't trust anything now! Worse yet, it seems some avarice spirits have possessed a collection of chests deep underground turning them into Mimics. Keep your eyes peeled for any chests laying around. They may not be what they seem...
Instructions.Translation: 我不知道你做了什么，小子，但看起来我们的差事多起来了。随着光与暗的能量被释放到这个世界，你现在不能相信任何东西！更糟的是，地底下似乎有些贪婪的精灵附身于宝箱上化作了宝箱怪。下次看到宝箱的时候得好好注意了，它们可能没看上去那么安全……

Instructions.Origin: The Dungeon is bad enough with skeletons and slimes roaming around, but with a Raging Minotaur loose, it gets even more complicated. That beast can charge at incredible speed, blindsiding anyone not paying attention and crippling their movement. Don't get staggered out there, kid.
Instructions.Translation: 地牢里面那些游走的骷髅和史莱姆已经够糟的了，不是吗？现在又有一头暴怒的牛头人使场面变得更加混乱。那头野兽能以极高的速度冲锋突袭那些走神的探险者，等到他们想逃跑时早已经来不及了。注意别被它的角刺到，小子。

Instructions.Origin: Don't be fooled, kid, the creature that lurks within the underground jungle is a being of pure terror, not beauty. Its mere existence is testament to our arrogance as individuals. It's... a moth!
Instructions.Translation: 你可别被表象所欺骗了，小子，那个在地下丛林中潜伏的怪物是纯粹恐怖的化身，和美丽沾不上半点边。它的存在既是对我们赏金猎人的挑衅！说的就是……那只蛾子！

Instructions.Origin: When the moon perfectly blocks the sun, the terror within us is released upon the world. My biggest fear has manifested as well. Hey, we don't choose what we fear, kid...
Instructions.Translation: 当月影完全遮蔽了日光,世界深处的恐惧就会被释放到这片大地之上.我最害怕的事情还是发生了.但是我们的字典中没有恐惧二字,小子...

Instructions.Origin: When the moon perfectly blocks the sun, the terror within us is released upon the world. My biggest fear has manifested as well in the form of a mutant moth! Hey, we don't choose what we fear, kid...
Instructions.Translation: 当月影完全遮蔽了日光，世界深处的恐惧就会被释放到这片大地之上。蛾怪——最害怕怪物，它还是出现了。但是我们的字典中没有恐惧二字，小子……

Instructions.Origin: You've got a good heart, kid. Don't let that be the end of you with this contract... Deep within the snow caves, there hides a creature masquerading as a defenseless young girl. Once close enough, however, you'll see she's not so defenseless. Take her out if you find her!
Instructions.Translation: 你心地善良，小子。但别让这成为你的弱点……冰雪洞穴的深处隐藏着伪装成无助少女的生物，一旦接近，她就会露出她的真面貌。一旦发现你发现了她，那就立刻干掉她。

Instructions.Origin: The Pigron are a rather bizarre hybrid of creatures. 50% pig, 50% dragon, and 100% evil. You might encounter them where the ice caverns meet the worlds evil. Beware their grumbling bellies as they approach; It's quite audible.
Instructions.Translation: 猪龙真的是一种奇怪的杂交生物。一半猪，一半龙，合起来是整一个邪恶生物。你可能在冰雪洞穴和世界邪恶地形交界处看到它们。可得小心，它们空荡的肚子发出的咕噜声老远就能听到。

Instructions.Origin: Never before have I heard of a creature with such terrifying power... It's pink, it's mean, and it journeys around with a powerful storm of slime. Destroy it!
Instructions.Translation: 我从未见过有具有如此恐怖气势的生物……它是粉色的，超级凶，它所到之处都会掀起强烈的史莱姆风暴。快去摧毁它。

Instructions.Origin: Have you heard tale of the pirates and their insatiable lust for gold? They can smell a coin from miles around, and from the looks of it, you've got quite a few. I would keep on guard for their inevitable siege. Make them regret attacking here by breaking one of their Flying Dutchman ships.
Instructions.Translation: 你听说过那些贪得无厌的海盗的故事吗？他们能从数英里之外嗅到一枚铜币的气味然后蜂拥而来，哦，看来你口袋里有不少钱。他们来袭的时候，我会保持警惕的。去摧毁一艘他们的荷兰飞盗船，让他们为这次入侵付出代价。

Instructions.Origin: Alright kid, I've got a bit of a double contract for you this time; a lot of our fellow townsfolk have severe cases of arachnophobia it seems. Rumors of a 'Brown Recluse' roaming the spider caverns have surfaced, but it seems like our only way to draw it out of hiding is to ALSO take down some kind of icy 'Gargantuan Spider', which prowls the tundra during harsh blizzards. If you can take both of them down, the folks around here should feel a lot safer.
Instructions.Translation: 听好了小子，我这次有一份双重合约给你。看起来镇子里的许多居民都有严重的蜘蛛恐惧症。谣传说最近蜘蛛洞穴中出现了一种叫“棕色遁蛛”的蜘蛛，而据我所知把它们逼出来的唯一方法就是干掉某只“冰霜巨型蜘蛛”，而符合条件的这种巨蛛只在飘飞着暴风雪的冰原上出现。如果你把这两种蜘蛛都干掉了，镇子里的居民肯定会感觉安全不少。

Instructions.Origin: The uncontrollable energies released by the Wall of Flesh's defeat have allowed some unsavory individuals to get quite a power boost. A rogue skeleton has harnessed the power of some long sealed spirits, and now terrorizes the underground as a Rune Wizard. His power is volatile and unpredictable; We can't allow him to live!
Instructions.Translation: 随着血肉之墙的倒下而释放出的那股能量使一些烦人的家伙获得了强大的力量。一具一直以来不断骚扰着被封印的魂灵的骷髅流氓借此力量化为了符文巫师，在地底世界作威作福。他的力量过于不稳定且难以预测……我们不能让他活着。

Instructions.Origin: An elemental's personality is heavily influenced by the environment it forms in. Considering sandstorms are rough, coarse, and dangerous, you can imagine why we would want to take down a few Sand Elementals. Watch your step for any nasty monsters wanting to take a bite out of you, kid!
Instructions.Translation: 一个元素灵的特性很大程度上是由她对应的环境所决定的。沙暴象征着粗野与危险，正因如此你应该去击败一些沙尘精。保持警惕，别让那些盯着你的怪物得手，小子。

Instructions.Origin: I've managed to track down quite an elusive dark caster in the deeper levels of our world by the name of... Tim. Names aside, he's got quite a bit of power behind him, but one fatal weakness. It seems he's quite prideful of his outfit, thinking his better than any other. Maybe you should wear a gem robe to lure him out...?
Instructions.Translation: 我在地底成功追踪到了一位行踪诡秘的黑暗法师，他自称是……蒂姆？名字先不提，他好像真的有点来头，但有一个致命的弱点。他对自己的打扮似乎十分自豪，认为自己比任何人都更懂穿搭。或许你可以穿一件宝石长袍吸引他出来切磋一下时尚知识？

Instructions.Origin: The winds of change are upon us it seems. But these winds don't seem to be in our favor... A nasty nest of Wyverns have found their way to the nearby sky islands floating just above our heads. I think it would be best for everyone if some of them were culled.
Instructions.Translation: 似乎风向的改变不是我们所能够干预的。但至少现在这些风并不是我们想要的……有群恼人的飞龙正处在空岛附近，那就在我们的头顶正上方。我想宰掉它们中的一些对大家来说都是好事。
